messages:
john: DeployBot flagged post-canary pre-upgrade job for billing-service v3.2.0 failed: Job 'preupgrade-migrate' stuck in Pending with '0/3 nodes are available: Insufficient memory'. Canopy still at 100% canary ready but promotion paused.

deploy-bot: DeployBot automated: Promotion blocked by hook failure. Canary health=100%, post-canary hook failed 1/1 attempts. Check: /deploy/logs/5551230000. Will retry hook in 2m.

lisa: Quick look 11 1 - the new chart bumped default values.memory.request for migrator from 256Mi to 1Gi. That preupgrade job requests full memory and can't schedule on smallest pools.

john: That's surprising, release notes didn't mention the migrator request increase. Was this from upstream chart or our values overlay?

infra: It's in the chart default - `templates/job-migrate.yaml` uses `.Values.migrator.memory.request` and our overlay didn't override. Upstream bump slipped through model onboarding.

mike: Options: 1) patch values in the release (set migrator.memory.request back to 256Mi) and re-run hook, 2) pin to previous chart revision and re-promote, 3) scale cluster quickly (not ideal in change window).

lisa: I prefer patching values and adding a follow-up to rationalize migrator memory. It's low-risk and keeps the chart version. We'll need a release note & a small rollback if anything goes wrong.

john: Agreed. Do we need a formal hotfix chart release or can we do a one-off helm upgrade with `--reuse-values --set migrator.memory.request=256Mi` in the canary namespace?

infra: One-off helm upgrade is fine for canary. For Dedicated we should cut a proper patch release. Also we should add a test in onboarding to detect memory request deltas.

deploy-bot: DeployBot automated: Received manual helm upgrade command for namespace billing-canary. Applying values override: `--set migrator.memory.request=256Mi`

mike: Hook retried, pod scheduling now succeeds. Pre-upgrade job completed: exit 0. Promotion continued.

john: Decision: apply temporary values override for canary, follow up with ENG-554 to publish chart patch (v3.2.1) that restores default migrator request and adds a CHANGELOG entry. Also add QA test in onboarding (ENG-555).

lisa: prepping release-notes entry and linking to ENG-554. PR: github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/998

infra: I'll add a monitor for values drifts so we catch default bumps next time.

john: leaving thread open until v3.2.1 cut and release-notes merged. Thanks team :rocket:
